Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to your sale this outstanding multi-unit residential investment property located on the highly sought-after Sarsfield Road in Ballinasloe.

This substantial investment property extends to over 2,500 sq. ft. and is currently configured into five self-contained residential units, comprising:

Three two-bedroom apartments
Two one-bedroom apartments

The property has been thoughtfully subdivided into well-proportioned units designed to maximise rental income and offers excellent potential for both seasoned investors and those looking to expand their residential portfolio.

Several of the apartments have already benefited from significant upgrades, including the installation of underfloor heating in some of the upper-floor units, while the remaining apartments would benefit from cosmetic refurbishment and pre-letting improvements, presenting an opportunity to further enhance both rental yields and capital value.

Ideally positioned in one of Ballinasloe's most established residential locations, the property enjoys excellent accessibility, with the M6 motorway and all local amenities just a short distance away, making it an attractive proposition for tenants.

If you are seeking a high-yielding multi-unit investment in a prime residential location with significant scope for further value enhancement, this exceptional property deserves your attention.
